source: Original synthetic scripts authored for TrickTic Dictate; no recorded speaker or private transcript.
consent_guidance: Read these scripts only with the speaker's consent. Keep recordings, identifiable transcripts and results in ignored storage outside Git. These scripts do not measure any particular speaker's accent.

samples.expected_text: Please schedule the meeting for Thursday after lunch.
samples.recording_guidance: Consenting speaker reads naturally in their own accent; aim for 60 seconds with additional separately transcribed content.

samples.expected_text: Open Metrix Writer and restart the TypeScript development server.
samples.recording_guidance: Compare identical audio with and without vocabulary hints.

samples.expected_text: אני רוצה לקבוע פגישה ביום חמישי אחרי ארוחת הצהריים.
תפתח את Metrix Writer ותבדוק את ה API לפני הפגישה.
samples.recording_guidance: Preserve English product and technical terms; use mixed preset.

samples.expected_text: אני אשלח את the final report מחר בבוקר before the meeting.
samples.recording_guidance: Switch language mid-clause. Human review must mark any unwanted translation event.

samples.expected_text: נועה ו Alex עובדים על Metrix Writer בתל אביב.
samples.recording_guidance: Fictional example names. Fix spelling in the reference before scoring.

samples.expected_text: Write a l e x at example dot com.
samples.recording_guidance: Score literal raw spelling; do not silently normalize to an address.
Reserved example.com address. Evaluate exact snippet expansion and cleanup separately from raw speech.

samples.expected_text: Start the note. ממשיכים אחרי ההפסקה. End the note.
samples.recording_guidance: Pause 5–10 seconds between sentences; do not speak this instruction. Check for added filler.

samples.expected_text: Beginning of the recording. סוף ההקלטה.
samples.recording_guidance: Placeholder bookends only: record at least ten minutes and replace expected_text with a complete human reference in a private manifest before audio scoring.
